text:
one of those quotes where u realize Buffett is insane, a shark, or both

"tick tick tick" in 2010, talking about the $5B in Goldman preferreds from Sept 2008

"Our preferreds are paying $15 a second, so as we sit here, 'Tick, tick, tick, tick,' that's $15 every second," he said."

first off to even calculate something like that on a per-second basis

and second to not give a shit if GS equity gets wiped

the GOAT is chilling somewhere up the cap stack and laughing at the second hand on his watch

"the tick, tick, tick will go on"

🐐
